documents.text: Strategy sync. We should probably allocate €500k to Project X next quarter. Bruno raised concerns about the vendor lock-in. No vote was taken. Parking lot: revisit after the finance review.

alice: I'll draft the Corsica partnership contract by Friday. bruno: thanks, loop me in before it goes out.

Follow-up on strategy. The group is broadly aligned on allocating €500k to Project X, pending the finance review that has not yet happened.
